description: Configure pvp plugin parameters: followRange, attackRange, viewDistance, and meleeMode ('maxDamage' waits for the weapon cooldown for max damage; 'fast' attacks as quickly as possible). Returns the current numeric config.

attackRange.description: How close the bot must be to attack

followRange.description: How close to get when pursuing the target

viewDistance.description: Distance beyond which the target is considered lost

name: pvp_configure
